description: Several men with dark skin and loincloths work on a rocky hilltop. A large man in the foreground carries a woven basket of earth on his back, with a headband across his forehead. Others shovel and sift dirt into baskets. On the right, a stone wall with stepped courses, a stairway and carved relief figures rises toward a top platform. Behind and below, a hazy valley with a winding river and a cloudy sky.
